title: Swift (bird)
blurb: The Apodidae, or swifts, form a family of highly aerial birds. They are superficially similar to swallows, but are not closely related to any passerine species.
facts: Swifts are placed in the order Apodiformes along with hummingbirds.
The treeswifts are closely related to the true swifts, but form a separate family, the Hemiprocnidae.
